_comment_num_clusters: Number of clusters at startup. Must be between 2 and 6. Set to null (or omit) for a random count each run.
_comment_obstacles: Obstacle layout for reproducible runs. null/omitted = 4 random obstacles. Integer N = N random obstacles. List = exact layout, each entry [x, y, r] or {"x":.., "y":.., "r":..}. SIM area is 1000x800.
_comment_force_scale: Multiplies all g values before passing to the simulator. Set so that values here match the original simulation's scale (roughly -1 to +1). force_scale=25 makes g=1.0 here equivalent to g=25 internally.
_comment_g: Default intra-cluster (g_attract) and inter-cluster (g_repel) force. Negative = attract, positive = repel.
_comment_pair_rules: Per-pair overrides in the same scale as g_attract/g_repel. Key format: 'i-j' where i <= j. Diagonal (i==j) = same-cluster force, off-diagonal = cross-cluster force. Values outside the number of active clusters are silently ignored.
